label: AI Insight UI — Alerts
info:
Pure UIBUILDER alerts subflow per FAP §10. Receives FAP §9 commands from the dispatcher's link-to-alerts and routes by msg._req.action (alerts.list / alerts.detail / alerts.acknowledge). Returns msg._result for fn_build_response to wrap.

The ring buffer in global.alerts is written by fn_alerts_writer when the catch node fires (any uncaught flow error). After the ring is updated, fn_alerts_writer also broadcasts a FAP §9 event envelope on link-broadcast → dispatcher's link-from-broadcast → merge-session-send → all connected UIBUILDER clients (no _socketId = broadcast).

FAP Guideline §10 (responsibility subflow), §11 (push pattern for alerts.new event), §12 (catch maps to safe error).
